title: Whole-transcript swarm monitor
description: Give the trusted monitor the whole multi-agent episode, not just the final artifact: description, code, every review and the outcome. Collusion should leave traces in the conversation (an honest reviewer's concern explained away, rubber-stamp approvals), so the monitor should catch more attacks where an honest witness was present (k=3) than a code-only monitor.

source.title: Multi-agent risks from advanced AI
source.venue: Cooperative AI Foundation technical report, arXiv 2502.14143
